name: Task Item Indicator
teaser: A small ring fades in when you're near a task item you still need, and the part facing it lights up so you know which way to turn. Same idea as the indicator live Tarkov added in 1.0.5.0, built from scratch for SPT.
description_html:
Description

Get near a task item you still need and a small ring fades in at the middle of your screen. The part of the ring facing the item lights up, so if it’s behind you the bottom lights up and you know to turn around. Get on top of it and the whole ring goes bright.

Live Tarkov added something like this in 1.0.5.0. SPT’s client is older than that patch so it never shows up. This isn’t their version ported over, it’s built from scratch to work the same way.

Only works on task items, the ones that go in your task items tab. A quest that wants three Salewas won’t light up every Salewa on the map.

Client side only, no server mod. Requires SPT 4.1.2.

Install Instructions
  1. Extract the archive
  2. Drop the BepInEx folder into your SPT root directory
Known Limitations / Bugs
  • With two task items in range it points at the nearest one.
  • Not tested with Fika, but should work since its client side only
Support

Found a bug or have a question? Leave a comment on this mod’s page, or reach out in my thread on the SPT Discord: https://discord.com/channels/875684761291599922/1521972310595338260
